pages.title: IPC and RPC Contract
pages.purpose: Typed MessagePort RPC contract: wire protocol, Api/Streams surfaces, preload bridge (piBridge), trusted desktop IPC, parent RPC, and how renderer reaches the Host.
instructions: Cite the wire protocol shapes in src/contract/rpc.ts and the handler registration in src/agent-host/handlers.ts.
Explain MessagePort forwarding through Main and why the port cannot cross contextBridge as a Promise value.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: The Electron three-process architecture: Main, Agent Host utilityProcess, sandboxed Renderer, Main-owned browser view, managed project processes, and the no-local-server principle.
instructions: Emphasize who owns which Electron process and why; cite main.ts wiring.
Include the README architecture diagram concepts only as far as source confirms them.

pages.title: Security Model
pages.purpose: Security posture: sandbox/contextIsolation/CSP, file-root allowlist, IPC sender trust, credential vault, channel and browser policy engines, and default-off capabilities.
instructions: Distinguish enforced invariants (checked by scripts/check-desktop-security.mjs where applicable) from design intent.
Note default-off capabilities and fail-closed behavior.

pages.title: Session Storage and File Access
pages.purpose: Where data lives (~/.pi/agent), session file index/watch, project/worktree resolution, and the file-access allowlist that gates Host file APIs.
instructions: Cover allowed-root derivation from sessions and cache invalidation behavior precisely.

pages.title: Adding a Channel
pages.purpose: Focused change guide: implementing a new messaging channel adapter (adapter interface, registry, config/state stores, policy, renderer channel UI surface).
instructions: Call out pairing/policy obligations and redaction requirements for a new adapter.
Cite the ChannelAdapter interface in src/agent-host/channels/types.ts and registry wiring.

pages.title: Adding RPC Methods
pages.purpose: Focused change guide: adding a new Api method/stream end-to-end (contract, Host handler, renderer client, contract coverage check).
instructions: Concrete step-by-step change guide with file touchpoints and the checks that must pass.

pages.title: Build and Testing
pages.purpose: Dev loop (Vite + tsup watch + Electron), build pipeline, the verify quality gate, unit/integration/e2e test scripts, and CI matrix.
instructions: List what npm run verify actually runs in order, citing scripts/verify.mjs.

pages.title: Packaging and Release
pages.purpose: Packaging with electron-builder, platform targets, bundled tools preparation, Windows helper build gates, and release workflows/signing/notarization.
instructions: Cite gates that verify packaged artifacts (verify-packaged-toolchains, windows helper reproducibility, SBOM).

pages.title: Updates and Diagnostics
pages.purpose: Auto-update pipeline (fixed GitHub Release config, user-confirmed download/install), logging, diagnostics export, host install recovery, and single-instance/tray/protocol app lifecycle.
instructions: Cover host crash recovery and renderer crash recovery surfaces.

pages.title: Agent Sessions
pages.purpose: Agent session runtime in the Host: wrapping pi-coding-agent sessions, agent lifecycle methods, event streaming, compaction/commands, and running-session tracking.
instructions: Explain the session title generation and model catalog refresh behaviors.

pages.title: Browser Integration
pages.purpose: Main-owned WebContentsView browser: tabs/profiles, policy engine, per-session grants, agent authorization flow, header rules, downloads, network capture, and advanced mode.
instructions: Cite grant types (persistent, runtime grant TTL, temporary session grants) and where authorization prompts originate.
Note cookie/secret handling guarantees.

pages.title: Managed Processes
pages.purpose: Managed long-running project processes: process_* agent tools, capability gating, POSIX process groups vs Windows Rust helper/Job Object, output cursor protocol, crash reaper, and shutdown cleanup.
instructions: Cite policy limits in src/shared/managed-process-policy.ts and capability gating in src/main/managed-process/capability.ts.
Clarify this is lifecycle containment, not a security sandbox.

pages.title: Messaging Channels
pages.purpose: WeChat, Telegram, and Feishu/Lark channels: adapters, inbound policy/pairing, lane scheduler, media handling, Pi session binding, outbound rendering, and state/secret persistence.
instructions: Cover the secret redaction and state-store dedup/persistence behavior.
State clearly that WeChat group support is not implemented in this repository if the code confirms it.

pages.title: Toolchain Management
pages.purpose: Toolchain discovery, probing, capability selection (node/python/git/search), managed runtime installation into app-private directories, bundled ripgrep/fd, and snapshot propagation to the Host.
instructions: Cite snapshot revision/ack protocol between Main and Host.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: what the app is, prerequisites, local dev loop, key commands, repository layout, and where to read next.
instructions: Ground every non-obvious claim in concrete source spans (repo:// paths with line ranges).
State uncertainty rather than inventing runtime behavior; source and tests are authoritative.
This is an Electron three-process app (Main / Agent Host utilityProcess / Renderer) wrapping @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.84.0; keep process ownership boundaries explicit.
